entries.value: It savagely defends an otherwise powerless or oppressed group, requiring service as the price
The chosen among the believers are granted uncanny powers or dark gifts
The faith bestows wealth and material prosperity on those who serve it
It allows an undead or otherwise unnatural state of extended life for devout servants
It gives practical protection against a plague, disaster, or constant threat
It provides political power through blackmail, vile favours, and dark works
Its principles are the comfortably established traditions of its hereditary believers
It provides intense experiences — visions, ecstasies, or physical pleasures — unavailable elsewhere
It provides muscle to its faithful followers, letting them terrorise their enemies
It justifies their worst impulses and gives divine rationale to a vicious subculture
It promises salvation from a coming catastrophe that will fall on all unbelievers
It gives its outcast adherents a sense of meaning, power, and belonging through its terrible majesty
